question: Magnesium sulphate is recommended for fetal neuroprotection in preterm labour at gestational ages less than 34 weeks to reduce the risk of cerebral palsy.

l10n.wrongAnswerMessage: Incorrect. This statement is true. MgSO4 is given for neuroprotection at <34 weeks; the indication is distinct from its use in pre-eclampsia (seizure prevention). Both indications share the same drug and loading dose protocol.
l10n.correctAnswerMessage: Correct. WHO and RCOG guidelines recommend MgSO4 4 g IV loading dose (over 20–30 min), followed by 1 g/hour maintenance, for fetal neuroprotection in imminent preterm birth before 34 weeks. This reduces the relative risk of cerebral palsy by approximately 30%.
